notes.title: 🕊️ Prepare to unveil the mysteries of Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy 🕊️
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

Get in your hydraloft in search of the mythical Great White Birds when [i]Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy[/i] lands in 2024!

[previewyoutube=lQf1kBoskWw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Set off on a quest for the Great White Birds in a mysterious land full of secrets[/h2]

Answer the call of exploration as you travel to [b]Amerzone[/b], a forgotten Latin American country, to fulfill the last wishes of a late explorer.

Investigate the ruins of this secretive land reclaimed by nature, meet intriguing characters with deep backstories and solve intricate puzzles to uncover the truth.

[h2]Will you unveil the mysteries surrounding the mythical Great White Birds?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5618793/bf2500829f737733cdcb5952f413f61ffe3fcf86.jpg[/img]

🌱 [b]A remake of the classic Benoît Sokal game[/b]
(Re)Discover the work of Benoît Sokal before the Syberia saga

🧭 [b]An ode to exploration[/b]
Discover a land shaped by mysteries and secrets as you travel through breathtaking environments

🕊️ [b]Face many challenges in search of the truth[/b]
Find clues and solve intricate puzzles to carry your quest for the Great White Birds in a faithful yet enriched story

🤝 [b]Meet fascinating characters[/b]
Learn about people with deep backstories, and listen to their stories to mend the errors of the past

🕊️ [b]Wishlist Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy now[/b]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Return to Mysterious Island, 33% off
notes.content:
Return to Mysterious Island is Now Available on Steam and is 33% off!

Join intrepid sailor and recent island castaway Mina as she explores the hidden secrets within the Jules Verne classic inspired Mysterious Island. Gather key articles left from the island’s previous inhabitants and combine them in unique and interesting ways to stay alive and stay hopeful for rescue. Surviving means more than living off this lush land, but also fending off the haunting resident specter and solving the islands deepest secrets!

Offer ends March 13th at 10AM Pacific Time
